message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This isolated DLL-component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; duplicate package names and obvious aliases were consolidated. The scan window was **2026-10-08 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-09 07:40 UTC** (**2026-10-08 13:10 IST through 2026-10-09 13:10 IST**).

No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated in that window could be matched directly to a component in the DLL inventory. The mandatory independent MongoDB ecosystem sweep identified **13 newly published CVEs** affecting official MongoDB drivers and `libmongocrypt`. Four have High CVSS v4 severity.

### Finding 1 — CVE-2026-106428

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C Driver
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 6.3 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** A malformed SCRAM server-final message can trigger a one-byte out-of-bounds read and terminate the client application.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106428) and [MongoDB CDRIVER-6370](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/CDRIVER-6370)

### Finding 2 — CVE-2026-106429

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB `libmongocrypt`
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 7.1; CVSS v3.1 6.5 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** A malformed KMS endpoint can cause integer underflow, allocation failure, and application termination; the record does not describe an out-of-bounds memory access.
- **Why relevant:** `libmongocrypt` is an official MongoDB client-side encryption library covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106429) and [MongoDB MONGOCRYPT-986](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOCRYPT-986)

### Finding 3 — CVE-2026-106430

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C++ Driver
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 6.0 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Embedded NUL bytes in field or collection names can make the driver and application interpret different targets, allowing unintended reads or collection renames with the application's credentials.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106430) and [MongoDB C++ Driver 4.6.1 release](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/mongodb-c-11-driver-4-6-1-released/344132)

### Finding 4 — CVE-2026-106431

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C Driver
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 5.9 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** An off-by-one error in the BSON bulk writer can write one byte beyond a heap allocation at a precise buffer boundary, corrupting memory or terminating the process.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106431) and [MongoDB C Driver 2.5.6 release](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/mongodb-c-driver-2-5-6-released/344130)

### Finding 5 — CVE-2026-106432

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB PHP Driver
- **Severity:** Low, CVSS v4 2.0 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Under a non-default configuration permitting near-4 GiB strings, a length conversion can wrap and cause heap corruption or terminate the PHP process.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106432) and [MongoDB PHP Driver 2.5.4 release](https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver/releases/tag/2.5.4)

### Finding 6 — CVE-2026-106433

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB `libmongocrypt`
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 8.7 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Duplicate `masterKey` fields can cause type confusion, invalid memory access, and invalid frees in the client process, potentially terminating it or corrupting memory.
- **Why relevant:** `libmongocrypt` is an official MongoDB encryption library covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106433) and [MongoDB MONGOCRYPT-964](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOCRYPT-964)

### Finding 7 — CVE-2026-106434

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB `libmongocrypt`
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 5.3 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Explicit decryption can return an unrecognized encrypted payload unchanged, causing an application to process attacker-modified bytes as plaintext.
- **Why relevant:** `libmongocrypt` is an official MongoDB encryption library covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106434) and [MongoDB MONGOCRYPT-966](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOCRYPT-966)

### Finding 8 — CVE-2026-106435

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Python Driver (PyMongo)
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 5.9 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Malformed BSON containing a truncated regular-expression element can cause an out-of-bounds read and terminate an application using the C extension; the normal database wire path is not affected.
- **Why relevant:** PyMongo is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106435) and [PyMongo 4.18.3 release](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/pymongo-4-18-3-released/344145)

### Finding 9 — CVE-2026-106436

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB PHP Driver
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 6.3 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Unchecked BSON append failures after exceeding the document-size limit can terminate a PHP worker or silently omit fields from the encoded document.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106436) and [MongoDB PHP Driver 2.5.4 release](https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver/releases/tag/2.5.4)

### Finding 10 — CVE-2026-106437

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C Driver
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 5.9 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** The BSON buffer-reservation API can accept an undersized buffer, leading to out-of-bounds reads and writes, memory corruption, or process termination.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106437) and [MongoDB C Driver 2.5.6 release](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/mongodb-c-driver-2-5-6-released/344130)

### Finding 11 — CVE-2026-106438

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB C Driver
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v4 5.1 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Decimal128 parsing can accept certain over-precision values with leading zeros and produce a different numeric value from the supplied text.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-106438) and [MongoDB C Driver 2.5.6 release](https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/mongodb-c-driver-2-5-6-released/344130)

### Finding 12 — CVE-2026-107324

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Go Driver
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 8.2; CVSS v3.1 5.9 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Integer overflow in BSON value-length handling can cause a runtime panic when an application validates or accesses malformed BSON, terminating an unprotected process.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-107324)

### Finding 13 — CVE-2026-107325

- **Affected product/component:** MongoDB Go Driver
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4 8.2; CVSS v3.1 5.9 (MongoDB CNA)
- **Description:** Missing BSON array-length validation can cause an out-of-bounds index panic when validating a malformed four-byte array, resulting in application denial of service.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official MongoDB driver covered by the mandatory ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-107325) and [MongoDB GODRIVER-4136](https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/GODRIVER-4136)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, `libmongocrypt`, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No additional credible in-window MongoDB-family finding survived freshness, product-match, and deduplication checks.

### Review priority

Immediate inventory review is recommended for `libmongocrypt` and the MongoDB Go Driver because four findings carry High CVSS v4 ratings, especially CVE-2026-106433 due to its memory-corruption impact. Review the remaining driver findings against deployed languages and versions during normal vulnerability triage. No direct action is indicated for the listed DLL components based solely on this 24-hour scan.
